newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products fall, except squeezed naphtha.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products fall, except squeezed naphtha.

text.p: NWE oil products, except cash naphtha, fell with crude's sharp drop on Thursday.
Naphtha swaps fell sharply with crude but cargoes were unchanged on a continued prompt squeeze.
Gasoline barges fell $4 and the arbitrage for larger vessels to the States started to creek shut.
Spot gas oil fell sharply as IPE gas oil futures slid nearly $10 a tonne and a glut of prompt supply kept buyers relaxed and differentials under pressure.
High sulphur fuel oil cargoes fell. High sulphur barges were volatile and traded between $95 and $100 fob ARA.
